title: Creamy Argentinian Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and flavorful pasta bake infused with Argentinian spices and a creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook the millet pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the Argentinian seasoning blend and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the light cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked pasta and creamy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until the top is golden brown.
